entities.name: Mykola Tsehelskyi

entities.summary: Mykola Tsehelskyi, sometimes rendered as Nicholas Tsehelskyi, was a Ukrainian Greek Catholic priest, considered to be a martyr by the Catholic Church for his refusal to convert even under duress.
